verdict: Under hypothesis (1) (integral vertices), an r=4 hive polytope with dim 3 and c = 4 is an empty lattice 3-simplex, all four of whose vertex-cone indices equal its normalized volume V.  Over ALL positively-spanning simple 4-subsets of the 15 fixed rhombus directions, the only constant index profile is (1,1,1,1).  Hence V = 1, at EVERY weight: the Reeve mechanism (which needs V = q >= 13) cannot fire in the r = 4 cell.  This is a bound on the mechanism, NOT evidence for the King-Tollu-Toumazet conjecture.
